User.title: User
User.description: Core authenticated user profile metadata (no PII stored directly on this document).

UserPrivateContact.title: UserPrivateContact
UserPrivateContact.description: Isolated PII document storing user email and private preferences under users/{userId}/private/{docId}.

celebratedDateKeys.description: Bounded list of YYYY-MM-DD celebration keys (max 365).

notificationPrefs.description: In-app and optional FCM notification preferences.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Server-provisioned platform administrator membership document (never writable from client SDK).

TrainerProfile.title: TrainerProfile
TrainerProfile.description: Public independent coach storefront profile (strictly free of private email/home address PII).

isDemoVerified.description: System-only legacy flag; forced false on client writes.

ClientProfile.title: ClientProfile
ClientProfile.description: Client fitness profile, training context, dietary/allergy notes, and active relationship pointer.

CoachingRelationship.title: CoachingRelationship
CoachingRelationship.description: Master relationship record linking a trainer and a client after explicit acceptance.

Invite.title: Invite
Invite.description: Trainer-issued invitation token with explicit status lifecycle.

Enrollment.title: Enrollment
Enrollment.description: Record of a client package enrollment under a coaching relationship.

ClientGroup.title: ClientGroup
ClientGroup.description: Trainer-managed cohort or goal group for bulk assignment and CRM filtering.

ClientGroupMember.title: ClientGroupMember
ClientGroupMember.description: Subcollection membership linking an actively linked client to a trainer's ClientGroup.

Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.description: Server-controlled package entitlement & billing period (never writable from client SDK).

PaymentRecord.title: PaymentRecord
PaymentRecord.description: Server-verified provider-agnostic payment & invoice record (Cashfree PG primary; legacy Razorpay preserved; never writable from client SDK).

Assignment.title: Assignment
Assignment.description: Scheduled daily commitment assigned by a trainer or created by an independent client.

scheduledDates.description: Bounded array of YYYY-MM-DD local date keys (max 31).

CompletionEvent.title: CompletionEvent
CompletionEvent.description: Completion log for a scheduled assignment date.

DailyActivity.title: DailyActivity
DailyActivity.description: Daily client hydration, steps, sleep, and recovery summary replacing localStorage telemetry.

StreakRecord.title: StreakRecord
StreakRecord.description: Persistent client streak summary derived from task completions and recovery approvals.

ProgressEvent.title: ProgressEvent
ProgressEvent.description: Body measurement, strength benchmark, or private check-in entry logged by a client.

WorkoutPlan.title: WorkoutPlan
WorkoutPlan.description: Structured weekly workout plan for a client.

MealPlan.title: MealPlan
MealPlan.description: Structured India-first meal plan for a client.

ConsultationSlot.title: ConsultationSlot
ConsultationSlot.description: Trainer consultation availability slot with atomic booking lock.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Client consultation booking atomically linked to a ConsultationSlot.

AIPlanDraft.title: AIPlanDraft
AIPlanDraft.description: Trainer-owned structured workout and nutrition plan draft.

nutritionOutline.description: Bounded array of nutrition guidance items (max 10).

AIGenerationLog.title: AIGenerationLog
AIGenerationLog.description: Server-logged Gemini request telemetry & usage quota record (client writes forbidden).

ConsentRecord.title: ConsentRecord
ConsentRecord.description: Immutable timestamped user consent record for privacy, health disclosures, and notifications.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Server-generated security and administrative audit trail (readable by admins only).

TrainerVerificationRequest.title: TrainerVerificationRequest
TrainerVerificationRequest.description: Trainer qualification verification request reviewed by platform administrators.

TrainerReview.title: TrainerReview
TrainerReview.description: Verified client review tied to an authentic CoachingRelationship.

CustomExercise.title: CustomExercise
CustomExercise.description: Trainer-created custom exercise extending the built-in FitPlus anatomical exercise library.

WorkoutSession.title: WorkoutSession
WorkoutSession.description: Completed or saved live workout execution record with set logs, volume, and PR tracking.

AchievementUnlock.title: AchievementUnlock
AchievementUnlock.description: Immutable, deduplicated achievement milestone unlocked by a client.

NutritionDiaryEntry.title: NutritionDiaryEntry
NutritionDiaryEntry.description: India-first daily nutrition diary with estimated macro logs, water tracking, and coach feedback.

WeeklyCheckIn.title: WeeklyCheckIn
WeeklyCheckIn.description: Structured weekly reflection check-in with ratings, optional shared progress photo, and trainer feedback.

ChatConversation.title: ChatConversation
ChatConversation.description: One-to-one conversation between an active trainer and client.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Individual message inside a FitPlus Connect conversation.

WorkoutProgramTemplate.title: WorkoutProgramTemplate
WorkoutProgramTemplate.description: Multi-week workout program template authored by a trainer in Workout Studio.

NutritionProgramTemplate.title: NutritionProgramTemplate
NutritionProgramTemplate.description: Visual Indian meal program template authored by a trainer in Nutrition Studio.

ScheduledReminder.title: ScheduledReminder
ScheduledReminder.description: Scheduled reminder or notification event for client engagement.

/users/{userId}.description: Core non-PII user metadata scoped strictly to the owning Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII (email, WhatsApp) and private preferences strictly readable/writable by the owner.

/admins/{userId}.description: Server-provisioned platform administrators (non-writable from client SDK).

/trainers/{trainerId}.description: Public independent trainer storefront profiles (no private PII).

/packages/{packageId}.description: INR coaching packages published by trainers.

/clients/{clientId}.description: Client profiles accessible only by the owning client and their actively linked trainer.

/relationships/{relationshipId}.description: Coaching relationships linking a client and trainer after explicit acceptance.

/invites/{inviteId}.description: Trainer-created invitation tokens with active/redeemed/revoked lifecycle.

/clientGroups/{groupId}.description: Trainer-managed client groups for targeted programming.

/clientGroups/{groupId}/members/{clientI.description: Membership documents under a trainer's ClientGroup.

/assignments/{assignmentId}.description: Daily commitments scheduled for a client.

/completions/{completionId}.description: Assignment completion logs used to derive streaks and adherence.

/dailyActivity/{activityId}.description: Persistent daily hydration, steps, and recovery records.

/streaks/{clientId}.description: Persistent client streak summary synchronized with completion history.

/progressEvents/{eventId}.description: Client progress measurements, check-ins, and optional private photo references.

/consultationSlots/{slotId}.description: Trainer consultation slots with atomic booking sync.

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Client-trainer consultation bookings atomically linked to slots.

/aiGenerations/{generationId}.description: Server-logged Gemini AI requests & rate-limit accounting.

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Admin-readable security and system audit logs.

/trainerVerificationRequests/{requestId}.description: Trainer credential verification submissions reviewed by admins.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Verified client reviews for published trainers.

/exercises/{exerciseId}.description: Trainer-created custom exercise entries supplementing the built-in anatomical library.

/workoutSessions/{sessionId}.description: Client live workout execution logs with set-by-set tracking and volume metrics.

/achievements/{achievementId}.description: Immutable deduplicated milestone achievement unlocks per client.

/nutritionLogs/{logId}.description: Daily India-first client nutrition logs with optional coach feedback.

/weeklyCheckIns/{checkInId}.description: Structured weekly client check-in reflections and coach review notes.

/conversations/{conversationId}.description: One-to-one coach-client messaging channel under FitPlus Connect.

/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.description: Messages inside a FitPlus Connect conversation.

/workoutTemplates/{templateId}.description: Trainer authored reusable multi-week workout program templates.

/nutritionTemplates/{templateId}.description: Trainer authored reusable visual Indian nutrition program templates.
